Pay per request in USDC on Solana or Base through x402 with no account: $0.001-$0.04 per data call, $5.00 per daily dataset file; prepaid keys ($0.10 trial, $2.00) serve clients without an x402 library. Responses report coverage, freshness and observed evidence.
info.x-guidance: Machine-payable pump.fun intelligence and Robinhood Chain (pons) launch structure. Call /v1/x402/resources or /llms.txt first. First step, no key and no payment: GET /v1/token_check/{mint} (any Solana mint or Robinhood Chain pons token, or its link) answers a verdict word, one reason and coverage. Paid GET routes return 402 with the x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (and the same JSON in the body); pay USDC on Solana mainnet (Coinbase CDP facilitator) or on Base (Coinbase CDP facilitator), exact scheme, and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Without an x402 client, buy a prepaid key once (/v1/keys/trial $0.10 or /v1/keys/new $2.00 in a browser wallet, or GET /v1/keys/transfer to pay with a plain USDC transfer from any wallet or exchange) and send it as the X-API-Key header. Every response is {ok, schema_version, generated_at, coverage: full|thin, data, meta{feed_lag_s, is_stale, next}}. Compact checks cost $0.005 for one mint or $0.01 total for up to five; full coverage and feed lag <= 5 s required. Free: /v1/token_check/{mint}, /v1/radar, /v1/check/coverage, /v1/check/watch, /v1/market/regime, /v1/sample/*, /health, /v1/labels. MCP at /mcp.

get.description: Use to check one Solana token in full: every measured field and calibrated odds for a pump.fun memecoin, a thin card for an older mint or any other SPL mint; for a quick pre-trade check use the $0.005 compact check (GET /v1/check/mint). Risk card for ONE pump.fun mint, always HTTP 200 for a valid base58 mint. coverage=full when the mint is in our live window: holders (count, top-5 share, HHI, create-slot bundle / insider / creator shares), rug/close flags with first-seen times, curve truth (graduation = curve witnessed >= 84 SOL), demand (unique buyers, buys/sells 60 s, net SOL), the creator's record at launch (no look-ahead), warm-launch (observed creator-funding links) label, exit signals, calibrated P(rug within 5 min) for young mints and P(true graduation). coverage=thin otherwise: our resolved launch record if any + current bonding-curve state and mint / freeze authority from RPC + creator prior. Any Solana SPL mint, not only pump.fun, gets the thin card: mint / freeze authority and the Token-2022 extensions that let someone seize, block or tax holders' tokens (permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee). Every card carries status, risk_label, confidence, a why[] list and market base rates. Nulls carry a reason; nothing is guessed. Every card also carries market (USD price, market cap = price x total supply as pump.fun and DexScreener show it, the curve's SOL liquidity in SOL and USD, the SOL/USD used and its time) and authorities (mint, freeze and metadata mutability: the pump.fun program rule on live mints, read on-chain on thin cards). A full card also carries the cohorts block: the supply held by the dev, bundlers and snipers with their wallets and SOL in and out of the curve, and top-1 and top-10 share (/v1/labels, cohorts), with the holders' reputation across tokens: the share held by known dumpers, repeat bundlers and wallets new to our tape (/v1/labels, reputation).

get.summary: Get Solana token holder concentration for a pump.fun mint
get.description: Use to measure the holder concentration of a Solana token on pump.fun from our ledger of its curve trades: its largest wallets and the creator's and create-slot buyers' shares; for who bought and sold trade by trade use GET /v1/mint/{mint}/flow. Up to 100 holders of one covered pump.fun mint, largest first, from our own per-wallet ledger of its bonding-curve trades: rank, wallet, share of supply, tokens, first-buy slot and time, last trade time, how the first tokens moved, buy and sell counts, and the labels we observe (dev = the creator, bundle = first tokens in the create slot or the next one, mayhem_agent; insider, latency_bot or skilled when the wallet is ranked on our pump.fun leaderboard, otherwise none). The concentration block carries the holder count, top-5 and top-10 share, HHI and the dev, bundle and insider shares the compact check reports. A cohorts block groups the supply by launch role: dev (the creator and the wallets our funding capture saw it fund), bundlers (first tokens in the create slot or the next), snipers (after them, within 2 s of the create slot: slots 2-8 on today's slots), each with its share of supply, wallet count, SOL in and out of the curve and its largest wallets, plus top-1 and top-10 share; each holder row names its cohorts. Labels are observations, not a verdict on a wallet. Full live coverage and feed lag <= 5 s required; an uncovered mint or a stale feed is refused unpaid. After a migration the ledger stops at the curve. The cohorts block also carries the holders' reputation across tokens: the share of supply held now by known dumpers (wallets that sold within 60 s of their first buy on 3 or more other mints), by repeat bundlers (in the create-slot bundle on 3 or more other mints) and by wallets new to our tape, from our own trade tape since 2026-09-27T00:18:34Z; each holder row carries its history on other mints (mints, bundled, quick sells, settled, rugged, graduated).
